_comment: Sokoban tutorial — minimal Phase A demo. Shows a welcome overlay on level 1 entry (tutorial_step==0), advances on ui_accept (Space/Enter). After ui_accept, tutorial_step becomes 1 and no further overlays fire. Tutorial state lives in world_state and persists via save_policy.json.

effect.title: Welcome to Sokoban
effect.body: Push every box onto a goal tile. Use WASD or arrow keys to move. Press R to restart a level. Press Space to begin.
